title.narrative: Strengthening the Science-Policy Nexus for Inclusive Policymaking in East Asia

description.narrative:
This workplan will strengthen the science-policy nexus in East Asia by promoting multidisciplinary approaches to address social transformations and the impact of global trends. It will support evidence-informed policymaking on issues such as climate resilience, disability inclusion, digital inequalities, youth development, anticipatory governance, humanities-informed policymaking and ethical governance of emerging technologies.
The work will promote research-policy mapping, science-based policy dialogue, knowledge exchange and practical policy recommendations. In Mongolia, activities will support the renewed MOST National Committee through a science-policy dialogue. In China, the work will connect disability-related practice with policy learning on inclusive education, accessibility, disability equality awareness and inclusive public services. Regional knowledge-sharing may be explored where relevant with countries covered by the Beijing Office and other technical partners.
